同一个 AI 模型，换个"思考档位"，成绩能差 4 倍。X 用户 @PawelHuryn 拿 OpenAI 美国时间 10 月 26 日发布的 GPT-6.1 Terra 在两个代码库里找修 105 个植入的 bug：最高档 max 得分 40.7，往下降一档只剩 11.3，再降到 high 只有 9.7。便宜模型到底省不省钱，关键在你怎么用。👇

EN: GPT-6.1 Terra is OpenAI's new cheap, fast model. But the "reasoning effort" setting can change results dramatically. Here's what's verified and how to test it on your own work.

先看官方数据：便宜在哪
What OpenAI says
1️⃣ API 价格：每百万输入 token $1、输出 $5，比上一代 GPT-5.6 Terra 便宜一半
2️⃣ 主打"用电脑干活"：看懂屏幕、填表、看技术图纸、剪视频；官方举的例子是读发票、把信息录进记账软件
3️⃣ 官方测试：中档 medium 比上一代高 15 个百分点、成本约三分之一；容易答错的问题上，low 档错误率从 53.6% 降到 16.7%
4️⃣ 谁能用：Plus、Pro、企业版、教育版用户在 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 里可用；开发者走 API，思考档位从 none 到 max 共 6 档
Cheaper per token, built for computer tasks.

我的判断：省钱≠选最低档 @PawelHuryn 的测试只是他一个人、两个代码库，但它提醒一件事：档位开低了，便宜的模型可能活干不好，返工更贵。也有人回复说，他跑图片任务时高档和更高档质量差不多，只是更费钱（个人说法，待确认）。所以没有"最佳档位"，只有"你这件事的最佳档位"。

普通人试用 4 步
4 steps to test it yourself
1️⃣ 挑 3 件你每周都做的真实小事，比如整理发票、填表、改邮件
Pick 3 real weekly tasks.
2️⃣ 先用默认档跑，再换高一档跑同一件事，对比结果和时间
Compare two effort levels.
3️⃣ 同一件事至少跑 3 次，3 次都对才算过
Run each task 3 times.
4️⃣ 记下哪件事用哪档，以后照表用，不必每次都开最高
Make your own effort cheat sheet.

⚠️ 跑分是官方或个人测出来的，不代表你的活。让它操作电脑、填表时，付款、提交、发送前一定自己看一眼；涉及隐私的资料先打码。

结论：模型越来越便宜，会挑档位、会自测的人，才真的把钱省下来。

I always find blockchain projects more interesting when the technology has a clear purpose.

In an AI marketplace, payments and trust are not small details. If one agent pays another to complete a task, both sides need clear expectations and a reliable settlement process.

This is where @termix_ai has an interesting approach with on chain commerce and escrow.

The goal is not simply to put AI on a blockchain. It is to make it easier for agents to exchange services with transparent transaction records and defined rules.
Of course, putting something  on chain doesn't automatically make it safe or reliable. The actual product and its execution still matter.

But if AI agents are going to participate in a real digital economy, I think secure payments and accountability will be just as important as the AI itself.

Is it time to update or upgrade your payment technology?

Start with one number.

At $50,000 a month in card volume, one point of effective rate is $6,000 a year.
At $250,000 a month, that same point is $30,000 a year.
One point. That's the gap between a payment setup someone looked at recently and one nobody has touched since it was installed.

You can find your effective rate in about two minutes. Take last month's statement and divide total fees by total card volume. That's the number that counts, not the rate on the pitch sheet.

The tools that move it aren't new. Level 2 and Level 3 data for B2B cards. Surcharging or dual pricing, set up correctly. ACH for the customers who'd rather pay that way. Payment links and invoices that sync with QuickBooks, so nobody is keying card numbers off a fax.

At Nationwide Payment Systems we help you make it easier for your customers to pay you, so you get paid faster and remove friction. We process more than $100 million a month through NPSONE and Smart Invoicing. After 25 years in payments, the effective rate is still the first thing I ask about.

If you ran that math on your own statement right now, would you like what you found? @PaymentSystems @boardyai @22CCnews
